name: Curated Target Within Genetically Implicated Process
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when Chemical causally affects gene in the decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral.; The pharmacologic target acts upstream of or within the genetically associated process The pinned descendant closure is biolink:acts_upstream_of_or_within, biolink:acts_upstream_of_or_within_negative_effect, biolink:acts_upstream_of_or_within_positive_effect.; The biological process has a forward genetic association to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:genetic_association. At least one primary source must be infores:geneticskp.
hypothesis: A curated drug target can intervene within a genetically implicated process without being a directly associated gene.

nodes.role: Biological process genetically associated with disease
nodes.explanation: Biological process genetically associated with disease.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: Chemical causally affects gene in the decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral.
edges.exclusion_rationale: This arm tests the exact stated relation; response, adverse, treatment, and other more-specific assertions would change its biological meaning.

edges.subject: gene
edges.explanation: The pharmacologic target acts upstream of or within the genetically associated process The pinned descendant closure is biolink:acts_upstream_of_or_within, biolink:acts_upstream_of_or_within_negative_effect, biolink:acts_upstream_of_or_within_positive_effect.

edges.subject: process
edges.explanation: The biological process has a forward genetic association to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:genetic_association. At least one primary source must be infores:geneticskp.

mechanism.rationale: A curated drug target can intervene within a genetically implicated process without being a directly associated gene. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} AND target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND target.object_direction_qualifier = "decreased" AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[upstream:{{relationship_types:upstream}}]->(process:BiologicalProcess) WHERE upstream.predicate IN {{predicates:upstream}} MATCH (process:BiologicalProcess)-[association:{{relationship_types:association}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE association.predicate IN {{predicates:association}} AND any(source IN ["infores:geneticskp"] WHERE source IN coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT process) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: target: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; target: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral; association: enforce primary-source membership in infores:geneticskp

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
